How to Apply
How to Apply
Students interested in applying to the Ph.D. in Biomedical Science at Herbert Wertheim College of Medicine should create an FIU Graduate School user account and password before beginning their application.
Applications do not need to be completed in one session. Applicants may save the application and log in later to complete the process.
Learn how to apply
Applications Open June 2, 2026
Apply
A $30 nonrefundable fee is due at the time of application. Applications are only processed once the application fee has been received. Applicants may pay the fee online using a major credit card (Visa, Master Card, Discover, or American Express).
Admission Requirements
Applicants must have a graduate degree or bachelor's degree from an accredited college in the United States or a comparable degree from a recognized institution of higher learning or have a minimum 3.0 GPA (on a four-point scale) in the last 60 credits of their undergraduate degree.
In addition to the above requirements, applicants must provide:
Three letters of recommendation attesting to an applicant's educational background, motivation, analytical skills, and promise as a research scientist. Recommendation letters must be written and submitted online by undergraduate advisors, research advisors, or professional colleagues.
Submit official transcripts from all colleges or universities attended. Transcripts must come directly from the issuing institutions to FIU. Applicants who attended or are attending FIU do not need to submit an FIU transcript.
Submit an up-to-date resume/CV and a statement of purpose highlighting future goals after obtaining the Ph.D. degree.
*GRE scores for the 2026 application are waived.
Additional Requirements for International Applicants
For questions regarding the international application process, contact iadmiss@fiu.edu or visit FIU International Admissions.
English Proficiency Test
Applicants that have earned a degree from a foreign non-English speaking country must take an English proficiency test and earn 550 paper-based, 80 internet-based on TOEFL, or 6.5 on IELTS.
Registration information is available at ETS or IELTS. For a list of exempt countries, see information for foreign-educated students. You must also translate your transcripts into English before submitting them to FIU.
Test scores must be dated within two years of the start of the program. Duolingo scores are being accepted for 2023.
International applicants are exempt from the English proficiency requirement if they:
Completed an associate’s, bachelor’s, or master’s degree at an institution in the United States.
Completed an associate’s, bachelor’s, or master’s degree at an institution accredited by a U.S. regional accrediting agency in a country where the language of instruction is English.
Earned a degree from an institution in an English proficiency test-exempt country.
Declaration and Certification of Finances Form
To obtain a certificate of eligibility, all international applicants must complete the Declaration and Certification of Finances Form and submit it to the FIU Graduate Admissions Office.
F-1 Graduate Student Transfer Form
Applicants transferring to FIU from another U.S. institution must complete the F-1 Graduate Student Transfer Form and submit it to the FIU Graduate Admissions Office.
Foreign Transcripts and Evaluations
FIU will require evaluations or translations of transcripts based on the type of applicant you are. Click here to learn more.
Submitting Your Application
Only completed applications are reviewed by the admissions committee. Any missing documents should be sent as soon as possible. Applicants may check for missing items by logging into their FIU Graduate School account and checking the “To Do” list.
Applicants must submit their application materials through the application portal. Applications should not be submitted directly to the College of Medicine.
All communications, including admissions decisions, are sent via email. Applicants should ensure that their email settings allow communication from gradadm@fiu.edu.
Once the applicant submits their application, it is delivered to the FIU Graduate Admissions Office electronically, and the applicant no longer has access to it.
For additional questions regarding the application process or the status of an application, contact us at biomed-phd@fiu.edu.

Application FAQs
Are GRE scores required for admission into the program?
GRE scores are waived for the 2026 admissions cycle. However, international applicants are encouraged to submit GRE scores.
Due to early deadlines for international students, we recommend preparing 12 months before the term you are applying to allow yourself enough time to take the GRE and retake it if necessary.
FIU only accepts test scores sent directly from the testing agency as official.
Can I apply for an application fee waiver?
There are no application fee waivers. Applications are managed by the University Graduate School, not the Ph.D. program.
May I apply to the Ph.D. in Biomedical Science if I have not finished my undergraduate degree yet?
Yes. However, if admitted, you must provide updated transcripts with your completed degree to finalize your admission.
Do you require interviews for admission into the program?
Yes, applicants must complete a virtual or in-person interview for admission to the Ph.D. in Biomedical Science program.
How do I find out if my application materials have been received?
To view your application status, you may log into MyFIU with your Panther ID and password to check whether transcripts have been received. The Graduate Admissions Office will post your documents to your application page as soon as possible. You can also email biomed-phd@fiu.edu for more information about your application status.
How are applications reviewed?
The Admissions Sub-Committee reviews completed applications in the order the applications become available. The Admissions Sub-Committee carefully considers your academic qualifications, letters of recommendation and statement of purpose.
How will I be notified of the admission committeeâs decision?
If accepted, you will be contacted via the email address on your application. You can view admissions decisions by logging in to the MyFIU student portal with your Panther ID and password. Please note that admissions decisions are provided only to applicants with complete applications.
